meta.name: FIT50 content engine facts
meta.source: Verified against the live FIT50 app and AGENTS.md. The generator receives the relevant facts in its prompt; the post-draft validator rejects any number or rule name that is not in this file. This stops the model inventing a tenth rule or a wrong price.

habit_names._comment: The nine rule names, exactly as they appear on the site. voice-lint asserts copy uses these spellings.

habit_targets._comment: Numeric targets from the live app and design system. The 'days' target is the 50-day challenge length.

Move Your Body.note: One bodyweight or KB/band workout a day

pricing._comment: Feed posts don't show the price. Price lives on the link-in-bio page, in Stories, in DMs. The exception is a time-bound launch post (never use on explainers).

resources._comment: Libraries the engine pulls from. The values reference file paths; the content lives in brand/libraries/.

voice_numbers._comment: Numbers that frequently show up in copy. voice-lint asserts the units are spelled British when they appear in body copy.

spelling._comment: British English spellings. voice-lint warns on the American variants in body copy.
